speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You are here, and the boy is here. The mornings I asked for have not begun. They begin this morning. Nobody prices them, and nobody reports them done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody will. I said the same on Sunday. I am not dressing one hour up as a cure.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Master Shakespeare. I can speak the line. I could speak it on Friday, until the call.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You speak it, Nick. The call went out from under you. Nobody laughed. I have not cut her, and I will not write her a line lower.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Again, Nick. Smaller in the throat. Not lower on the page. The page stays.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Nurse!

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: That is the place. Stop. We are not mending it by pushing it. We are nursing it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stop is right. You are not to be made well before dinner, Nick. One morning is one morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Shall I go again, Master Shakespeare?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once more, and then the king. I am Gaunt at two. This hour is yours, not his.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Nurse!

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the better. I did not hear a mend. Do not smile it into one, Nick.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am not smiling, Master Shakespeare. It still goes thin at the end.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Better, and not mended. You hear it. I am not going to tell the sharers it is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. The crack is where Friday left it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: John will not hear a price. There is no price. There is a boy, and a call, and a morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not ask to be written down, Master Shakespeare. The line is hers. I only lost the way into it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You did not lose her. You lost the call. We will find the call by doing it, not by shortening her.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Enough for a first morning. You have a king to put on. Nick, the call waits for the next morning. You do not spend the Queen proving a cure we do not have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you do not try the call in a stair. A morning is this room. The Queen this afternoon is a different part.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not mix them, Master Shakespeare. The Queen is this afternoon. The call can wait.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Good. He is not to try it in the tiring-house. The yard does not get a boy's throat twice.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will go and be dressed, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. The afternoon is Gaunt. I am not bringing this hour onto that stage.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Leave it here. Go and be old. He will be the Queen, and that is a different part.
